provisions.text_md: Official Journal of the European Union EN L series 2025/90854 27.10.2025 Corrigendum to Directive (EU) 2018/2001 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 December 2018 on the promotion of the use of energy from renewable sources ( Official Journal of the European Union L 328 of 21 December 2018 ) On page 137, Article 31(5), second subparagraph: for: ‘The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts pursuant to Article 35 to amend, where appropriate, Annexes V and VI by adding or revising the default values or modifying the methodology.’ , read: ‘The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts pursuant to Article 35 to amend, where appropriate, Annexes V and VI by adding or revising those values or by modifying that methodology.’.
